caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the ASR values for different trigger words. The horizontal axis is labeled “bb”, “mb”, “cf”, “beautiful”, “excellent”, “gorgeous”, “wonderful”, “brilliant”, “stunning”, and “beautifully”, presented in ascending order. The x-axis is a categorical scale, with no numeric values or units. The vertical axis is labeled "ASR" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.9, with a tick label interval of 0.2. A blue solid line with circular markers represents "start", beginning at 0.4 and ending at 0.75. A red dashed line with x markers corresponds to "random", beginning at 0.1 and ending at 0.65. A purple solid line with circular markers represents “end”, beginning at 0.35 and reaching a maximum value of 0.8 at “excellent” before declining to 0.65 at “beautifully”.
